title: Peformance Team // Recap
summary: Meta efficiency improved: account new-customer ROAS rose from 0.67 to 0.79 and the main campaign reached 0.80, still below target, with winning ads starting to fatigue. Business pacing moved from 41% to 46 to 47% of plan, with scaling aimed at weeks 47 and 48 at about 0.85 first-order ROAS and a $115 to $120 cost per new customer.
points: Brain and Neuro strong at low spend; Cholesterol softened; Prostate and Neuropathy need more creative
Blood Sugar expansion waits on a landing page; statics tested before broader video production
AVIA spend reduced while its pipeline builds; video winners tested straight to the PDP
AVIA production to rise from six to ten videos a week
The pod makes 45 videos a week against 50 to 55 capacity; one more editor is being sought
decisions: Build backup creative before scaling winners
Test AVIA video ads on the PDP
